# `style/ComputedStyle.js`

> **Source:** `plauna/style/ComputedStyle.js`

ComputedStyle - Style resolution and caching system for Plauna. Style resolution pattern: - Handles style inheritance from parent nodes - Resolves design token references - Computes final style values for rendering - Caches computed styles for performance - Tracks performance statistics Architecture: - cache: Map of computed style results - tokenCache: Map of resolved token values - styleCache: Map of style property resolutions - performanceStats: Metrics for cache hits/misses and timing Style categories: - Position and layout: position, display, flex properties - Sizing: width, height, min/max dimensions, flex basis/grow/shrink - Spacing: margin, padding - Visual: colors, borders, shadows, opacity - Typography: font family, size, weight, line height, alignment - Interaction: pointer events, cursor - Accessibility: visibility, z-index - Transform and animation

## Notes & Examples

### App & widget lifecycle

Plauna apps and widgets follow a **mount → update → unmount** lifecycle; services (storage, command bus, theming) are *injected* rather than imported, so the same widget runs in the editor, the OS shell, and standalone.

**See also:** [Plauna Architecture](/plauna/architecture.md) · [Plauna Overview](/plauna/overview.md)

### App & widget lifecycle

Plauna apps and widgets follow a **mount → update → unmount** lifecycle; services (storage, command bus, theming) are *injected* rather than imported, so the same widget runs in the editor, the OS shell, and standalone.

**Example: Widget with full lifecycle**
```js
import { Widget } from 'plauna/core/Widget.js';
import { useStorage, useCommands } from 'plauna/hooks.js';

class CounterWidget extends Widget {
  mount(container, services) {
    // Inject dependencies
    this.storage = useStorage(services);
    this.commands = useCommands(services);
    
    this.el = document.createElement('div');
    this.count = this.storage.get('count', 0);
    this.render();
    container.appendChild(this.el);
    
    // Register commands
    this.commands.register('counter:reset', () => {
      this.count = 0;
      this.render();
    });
  }
  
  update(props) {
    if (props.increment) this.count++;
    this.render();
  }
  
  render() {
    this.el.textContent = `Count: ${this.count}`;
    this.storage.set('count', this.count);
  }
  
  unmount() {
    this.commands.unregister('counter:reset');
    this.el.remove();
  }
}
```

**See also:** [Plauna Architecture](/plauna/architecture.md) · [Plauna Overview](/plauna/overview.md)
